tool.audit_method: ESLint.lintText against exact Git objects using the repository Anti-Slop audit config

candidates.message: Empty state text found without actionable wording or a usable control in its local UI block.
candidates.review_rationale: The matched text is a pull-request push-state value, not an empty-state message or action boundary.
candidates.next_action: Narrow the rule so status-value text such as Unknown or No upstream does not trigger the empty-state heuristic.

candidates.message: Generic label `Analytics` detected. Prefer domain-specific wording.
candidates.review_rationale: Analytics repeats the surrounding navigation concept without naming the repository signals shown in the panel.
candidates.safe_direction: Use a domain label such as Repository trends or Repository health and delivery.

candidates.message: This function stacks 3 defensive null/record guards. Centralize shape validation in a small helper instead.
candidates.review_rationale: The inline comparator repeats null handling and ranking policy, making the visible sort contract harder to read and test.
candidates.safe_direction: Extract a named comparison helper that preserves null-last ordering and the alphabetical tie break.
